protocol.fixture: same thoughtexperiment positive/negative fixture; candidate/rule objects retained but not executed
protocol.isolation: one fresh Python/native process per backend × size × iteration; measure smaps_rollup before fork, while branch lives, after one branch-local node insertion, and after branch drop plus GC
protocol.memory_metrics: Linux current RSS/PSS and private/shared clean/dirty pages; these include Python, engine, fixture, branch, and loaded runtime state
scope_limits: smaps_rollup current state, not kernel peak RSS
does not run inference or candidate prediction
post-drop pages may remain in allocator arenas
protocol.semantic_gate: branch adds one node without changing primary graph/rule revisions/counts; source-compatible fixture across backends
